_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. W-band Photonic ISAC (FiWi). Flexible TFDM waveforms (LFM+SCM) generated photonically and transmitted over 10km fiber + 1m wireless.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Flexible TFDM waveform concepts (Cases 0-9). Fig 2: Experimental setup (CO -> 10km Fiber -> BS -> 1m Wireless -> UE). Fig 3: BER/SNR/Resolution trade-offs.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic-aided W-band ISAC (FiWi). Sensing: LFM Radar (De-chirp). Comm: SCM 32-QAM. Method: Flexible resource allocation (TFDM) between LFM and SCM.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 15-60 Gbps (SCM SCM). Sensing: 1.59-4.39 cm resolution. Fiber: 10 km. Wireless: 1 m.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Addresses trade-off between sensing resolution and comm rate using flexible waveform design. Leverages photonics for wideband W-band signal generation.

bibliographic.title: Photonic-based W-band Flexible TFDM Integrated Sensing and Communication System for Fiber-wireless Network
bibliographic.authors: Boyu Dong, Junlian Jia, Guoqiang Li, Jianyang Shi, Haipeng Wang, Zhenzhou Tang, Junwen Zhang, Shilong Pan, Nan Chi

application.scenario_description: Fiber-wireless integrated network (CO to BS via Fiber, BS to User via Wireless) serving comms and radar sensing.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Flexible TFDM waveform for W-band Photonic ISAC enabling adaptive resolution/rate.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Rigid resource allocation in electrical ISAC and lack of fiber integration in photonic ISAC.

transmitter.notes: Photonic generation of 96.5 GHz W-band signal (12 GHz bandwidth). SCM 32-QAM + LFM.

receiver.notes: 100 GHz PD at BS (O/E conversion). Wireless Rx with ED for Comm. De-chirp for Sensing.

integration.notes: Flexible TFDM: FDM, TDM, or Mixed. Shared Photonic HW.

channel_fibre.notes: Fiber used for transport (RoF), not intrinsic sensing.

tradeoff.notes: 9 Cases showing trade-off between Radar Bandwidth (Resolution) and Comm Bandwidth (Rate).
